title: Drew Campbell and the Surprising Journey on Big Brother 28
seoTitle: Drew Campbell and the Surprising Journey on Big Brother 28
subtitle: The former dental assistant reached the final three, won the Time Capsule, and almost won the public vote
excerpt: 22-year-old Drew Campbell stood out on Big Brother 28, winning six competitions, never receiving an eviction vote, reaching the final three, and being a fan favorite.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Drew Campbell, the 22-year-old dental assistant, became one of Big Brother 28's most talked-about names by reaching the final three and leaving his mark in several competitions and votes.

Drew Campbell's Journey on Big Brother 28

From the start, the participant sought to observe the game field and get close to the season's icons, taking on the role of a “middleman” between factions. He describes entering as a fan of the show and, over 87 days, managed to remain without a single eviction vote against him, except in the finale.

Achievements and Competition Wins

Drew accumulated six competition wins, just one victory shy of Rick Devens, the season's biggest winner. Among his standout moments, he almost made history in the Pressure Cooker challenge and won the Power Veto on another occasion.

Alliance Games and the Strategy of Playing Both Sides

He admitted to playing both sides of the house, “stealing information” from one group and taking it to the other, which ultimately labeled him the “middleman.” Despite the criticism, he states that his alliance with the icons was essential for him to advance.

Final Moment and Eviction Vote

In the final three, Rick Devens decided to eliminate Drew, a decision the participant acknowledged as correct, although he said that, in Devens' place, he would have chosen someone else. The final vote resulted in Devens defeating Taylor Brown 6 to 1.

Drew's Reactions and Future After the Show

In an interview, Drew commented that being in the Time Capsule, securing the “Never Not Pass,” was “the coolest” and that being among the public's top three favorites was even more exciting. He also spoke about his “hot mess” relationship with Melody Morris, describing it as fun and leaving open the possibility of them remaining friends. When “zinged” by Zingbot, he responded with “F--k that guy,” demonstrating his humor in facing the criticism.

The Legacy of a Fan Who Lived the Dream

Drew concluded by saying that living 87 days inside the house was the fulfillment of a dream he had nurtured since he was eight years old, and that he would be ready to return to the game in future editions.

With information from TV Insider, Gold Derby.
